question: Estimate the hospital beds India needs to add over next 5 years to meet healthcare demand.
idealClarificationQuestions: Public + private hospital beds? Yes — total.
WHO recommendation reference: 3 beds per 1,000 population? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × bed-per-1000 target − current bed availability.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: India current bed count (public + private): ~1.9-2M (1.3 per 1,000).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Realistic addition over 5 years: ~600K-800K beds (~120-160K/year — current pace ~100K/year).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Note: India will not fully close the gap to 3/1,000 in 5 years; infrastructure constraints.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: India will not fully close the gap to 3/1,000 in 5 years; infrastructure constraints.

calculationFlow: WHO recommendation: 3 beds per 1,000 = 4.5M beds total target.
India current bed count (public + private): ~1.9-2M (1.3 per 1,000).
By 2031, India will have ~2.6-2.8M beds = 1.7-1.9 per 1,000.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Note: India will not fully close the gap to 3/1,000 in 5 years; infrastructure constraints.
